title: WildprintManifest
description: Manifest of all generated wildlife illustrations. Each record represents one generated image (one variation of one (species, style) pair). The manifest is maintained by scripts/build_manifest.py, updated by scripts/normalize_images.py, and mutated by scripts/select_master.py. It is also read by the Flask review app.

species_slug.description: Stable, lowercase, hyphenated identifier for the species (e.g. 'red-fox'). Used in filesystem paths and as part of the composite key (species_slug, style_slug, variation).

species_common_name.description: Human-readable common name for the species (e.g. 'Red Fox'). Sourced from data/species/species.json at generation time.

style_slug.description: Stable, lowercase, hyphenated identifier for the illustration style (e.g. 'vintage-naturalist'). Used in filesystem paths and as part of the composite key.

style_name.description: Human-readable name of the illustration style (e.g. 'Vintage Naturalist Plate').

provider.description: Which image generation provider produced this image (e.g. 'openai', 'replicate', 'mock'). Matches the providers/ module names.

model.description: Specific model identifier used by the provider (e.g. 'gpt-image-1'). Recorded verbatim from the generation request.

image_size.description: Requested output size from the provider, formatted as 'WIDTHxHEIGHT' (e.g. '1536x1024'). This is the provider's native size, before normalization to the print canvas.

prompt.description: The fully rendered prompt string sent to the provider. Contains style instructions and species-specific details. Useful for debugging and for reproducing a generation.

variation.description: 1-based variation index for this (species_slug, style_slug) pair. Corresponds to the 'v{n}' suffix in filenames.

seed_requested.description: Seed value the script asked the provider to use, if any. May be null when no deterministic seed was requested.

seed_used.description: Seed value actually used by the provider, if the provider reports it. May be null when the provider does not expose or support seeds.

supports_seed.description: Whether the provider/model combination supports deterministic seeding. When false, seed_requested and seed_used are expected to be null.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp (e.g. '2026-04-11T14:32:08Z') recorded when the image was successfully generated.

raw_path.description: Filesystem path (relative to project root or absolute) to the raw PNG as returned by the provider. Convention: 'output/raw/{style_slug}/{species_slug}/{species_slug}_{style_slug}_v{n}.png'.

normalized_path.description: Filesystem path to the normalized (cropped, centered, white-canvas) PNG. Set by scripts/normalize_images.py. Null until the image has been normalized. Convention: 'output/normalized/{style_slug}/{species_slug}/{species_slug}_{style_slug}_v{n}.png'.

selected_as_master.description: Whether this variation has been chosen as the canonical master image for its (species_slug, style_slug) pair. Exactly one record per pair should have this set to true at any given time. Managed by scripts/select_master.py.
